description: Phoenix is an Elixir web framework. It uses a router, controllers and a connection value to handle requests. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Create an app named school with mix phx.new school --no-ecto --no-html --no-assets. Enter school and run mix deps.get. Put each labelled section in its named file, then run mix phx.server. Use http://127.0.0.1:4000.
versionNote: Examples use Phoenix 1.7 with Elixir 1.14 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Make a controller reply with Phoenix
Report a missing item with Phoenix
Return a JSON list with Phoenix
learningObjectives: Make a controller reply with Phoenix
Check a path number with Phoenix
